author: Play On Tabletop
description:
We've done it before, and we've brought it back.  The Play on Marathon live stream.  We start with 2000 points at the table and through audience support we bring in more and more minis.  We pledge to keep playing till one side runs out of minis or 24 hours.  Whichever comes first.  Which is up to you!

This is a fundraiser live stream where we are raising money for future projects and studio expansion.
